research_goal: Advance direct reproducible vector-based control of an admitted FREE API model through Global J-Space without confusing nominal model identity, output-logit control, provider routing, or local mechanism evidence with hidden-state/runtime causal credit.

hosted_logit_control_current_behavior: Binds a concrete FREE Qwen3-0.6B OpenRouter model slug to route-specific zero-price evidence.
Binds upstream weights repository/revision and tokenizer.json digest in the request identity.
Correctly scopes any success to OUTPUT_LOGIT_VECTOR_CONTROL_COMPONENT_ONLY rather than hidden-state/J-Space steering.
repo_observations.new_gap: The current request identity does not bind the concrete upstream OpenRouter provider endpoint/variant or quantization actually serving the call, and the normal request path does not require OpenRouter router metadata. A concrete model slug therefore does not by itself prove invariant runtime identity across matched controls.

external_primary_source_observations.finding: OpenRouter routes a model across eligible providers by default; callers can constrain provider order/only, disable fallbacks, require supported parameters, and filter quantization. Provider choice is therefore a material runtime variable distinct from the model slug.

OpenRouter supports X-OpenRouter-Metadata: enabled, returning openrouter_metadata that exposes routing decisions, retries/fallback behavior and other router actions. This is a direct measurement surface for the missing runtime-route identity.
The Qwen3-0.6B concrete :free model slug is published at zero prompt/completion price. This proves route price identity, not exact upstream execution bytes or hidden-state intervention support.

Activation-source selection materially changes activation-steering effectiveness. Execution-boundary states and tail subtraction are reported as stronger/stabler steering-signal sources in the studied settings, making source-selection a causal calibration variable rather than a fixed implementation detail.

hypothesis.runtime_identity: Matched Trigger-1 controls can be confounded when the concrete upstream provider endpoint, quantization, or runtime path differs between calls even if the OpenRouter model slug, prompt, seed and logit vector are fixed.
hypothesis.basis_source: For the hidden-state/cvec lane, basis vectors derived from execution-boundary activations with tail subtraction may produce a more directional and stable holdout effect than vectors derived from unlocalized prompt/continuation activations.

counterhypotheses: The concrete Qwen3-0.6B :free slug may currently resolve to only one invariant upstream endpoint/quantization, in which case explicit provider/runtime binding adds observability but does not change measured variance.

Execution-boundary source selection may not transfer to the exact Qwen3-0.6B/llama.cpp Trigger-1 setting; apparent gains could be task- or architecture-specific and must be tested on calibration then frozen before holdout.

openrouter_runtime_identity: Enable X-OpenRouter-Metadata for Trigger-1 hosted-control calls.
Persist a canonical digest plus nonsecret provider/endpoint/route/quantization fields from openrouter_metadata into the execution receipt.
When an exact eligible provider endpoint is known, set provider.only (or exact order) and allow_fallbacks=false; bind an explicit quantization filter where the provider publishes one.

Require the same observed provider endpoint/variant, quantization class and system_fingerprint across BASELINE, +VECTOR, SIGN_FLIP, NULL_VECTOR, ORTHOGONAL_SAME_NORM and PERMUTED_SAME_NORM before attributing a fixed-seed output-logit effect to the vector.
If any required runtime identity field is absent or changes, classify the batch as RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and mint zero causal steering promotion credit.
basis_source_calibration: On the first admitted local instrumentable Qwen3-0.6B runtime, construct at least two basis-source candidates on calibration only: current/default activation source and execution-boundary plus tail-subtraction source.
Use identical downstream layer/gain/control families when comparing source candidates so source selection is the only intended changed variable.
Freeze source method, selected layer/range and gain before disjoint holdout; reject any holdout-informed source re-selection.
Promote only if the chosen source improves directional effect without increasing NULL/orthogonal/permuted off-target effects and survives fixed-seed disjoint holdout.

ten_lane_delta.runtime_surface: ADVANCED: exact FREE Qwen route exists, but exact upstream provider/quantization/runtime identity remains unbound; router metadata is the cheapest direct discriminator.
ten_lane_delta.adapter_identity: ADVANCED: activation-source selection becomes an explicit calibration-only identity component; source method must be frozen and receipt-bound before holdout.
ten_lane_delta.layer_localization: UNCHANGED: still calibration-only and frozen before holdout.
ten_lane_delta.gain_calibration: UNCHANGED: still calibration-only and frozen before holdout.
ten_lane_delta.seed_holdout_reproduction: HARDENED: require stable observed runtime-route identity across the entire matched-control family in addition to fixed seeds and disjoint holdout.
ten_lane_delta.receipt_chain_and_delta_forge: ADVANCED_SPEC: receipt should bind OpenRouter routing metadata digest and nonsecret runtime-route identity before any output-logit causal attribution.

epistemic_boundaries: A concrete OpenRouter model slug plus an upstream Hugging Face revision does not prove that the hosted runtime consumed those exact bytes.
provider routing metadata can identify routing behavior but still does not attest exact model weight bytes unless the provider supplies that evidence.
Hosted logit_bias is output-logit control, not hidden-state/cvec steering.
Local llama.cpp/PyTorch activation intervention remains mechanism evidence only until exact runtime identity, matched controls and disjoint holdout pass.
The activation-source-selection paper is a transferable hypothesis source, not proof that the method improves Trigger-1 on Qwen3-0.6B.
next_exact_action: Fuse OpenRouter router-metadata/runtime-route identity binding into the bounded Trigger-1 Qwen3 hosted-control executor, then run the six matched controls only on an admitted exact FREE lane. In parallel, on the first admitted local instrumentable Qwen3-0.6B runtime, compare default versus execution-boundary+tail-subtraction basis sourcing on calibration only and freeze the winner before holdout.
